events.summary: A Cabal patriarch's champions are punished with a shake of his finger.
events.quote: When one of the Patriarch's champions displeased him, he would only shake his finger.

events.summary: Kamahl declares he came to the pits to win.
events.quote: I didn't come to play. I came to win.

events.summary: Emperor Aboshan declares that all life will return to the sea.
events.quote: From the sea came all life, and to the sea it will return.

events.summary: Braids kills creatively rather than snapping a finger to yank a soul.
Pianna assesses Lieutenant Kirtar's strengths and weaknesses.
events.quote: His strengths are pride, devotion, and ambition. His weaknesses are the same.
To say Nixar had a splitting headache would be a bit of an understatement.
